items.title: Anthropic’s IPO Could Change the Path for Other AI Companies – JDP Global
items.snippet: Companies such as OpenAI and other major AI developers could find that investors...
items.raw_snippet:
Companies such as OpenAI and other major AI developers could find that investors are increasingly willing to support the valuations being established in private funding rounds. It could also make the public markets more attractive to companies that have previously viewed an IPO as unnecessary or premature.

The opposite outcome would be just as important. [...] A major Anthropic listing would introduce a different test.

Once shares are publicly traded, the company would be subject to the daily judgement of a much broader investment market. Revenue growth, operating costs, access to computing power, capital requirements and the prospects for long-term profitability would all come under considerably greater scrutiny.

For other AI companies, the outcome could be important.

## A public valuation could reset expectations [...] Anthropic therefore has the potential to become an important reference point for the wider AI sector.

If investors place a very high valuation on the company and that valuation holds after the initial excitement of the listing, it could provide further evidence that the market is prepared to assign substantial value to companies building advanced AI systems.

That would be significant for privately held competitors.

items.title: OpenAI 排除 2026 年 IPO 可能，Sam Altman 优先推进 AI 安全工作
items.snippet: Altman 表示 OpenAI 暂无上市压力，更聚焦 AI 安全研究。
items.raw_snippet:
Altman said OpenAI currently feels no pressure to become publicly traded and characterized the present environment as an inappropriate time to undertake an IPO given the safety questions surrounding increasingly capable AI systems.

The comments provide greater clarity around OpenAI’s near-term capital markets plans after previous reports suggested the company had been evaluating the timing of a potentially enormous public offering. [...] The comments came as Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei separately called for AI companies to take a more deliberate approach to advancing model capabilities. Altman subsequently said he agreed with the broader idea of pacing development at the frontier.

For OpenAI, postponing an IPO would leave the company reliant on private capital and strategic financing arrangements while it continues investing heavily in computing infrastructure, model development and safety research. [...] Asked whether a 2026 IPO was effectively off the table in favor of 2027, Altman specifically ruled out 2026 but did not commit to a listing date for the following year.

His comments were closely tied to concerns about increasingly powerful AI models. Altman said that even hypothetical estimates suggesting a meaningful probability of AI contributing to human extinction should be treated as unacceptable rather than as an ordinary business risk.

items.snippet: Ivoflow 软件利用 AI 自动核查，提升制造商采购与定价效率。
items.raw_snippet:
Ivoflow's software uses AI to automate that check. It reads a supplier's price-increase request, breaks down what's actually driving the cost (raw materials, currency, labor), compares that against real market data, and tells the buyer how much of the requested increase is justified and how much is not. As an example, a supplier's requested 6% price increase held up to only 1.3%, once checked against actual cost drivers. The same approach also scans a company's full spend on its own, flagging [...] Where AI comes in

Manufacturers routinely receive requests from suppliers to raise prices, citing higher costs for steel, plastic, or other raw materials. Checking whether each request is actually justified takes a lot of manual work, so many get approved without a real check, and unjustified increases quietly eat into a company's profit. [...] Investing in growth

Jaggaer intends to invest in the Ivoflow team, product, and roadmap, including expanding its AI-driven capabilities, such as scenario modelling, savings-probability generation, and proactive procurement guidance. Ivoflow's co-founders, Daniel Demuth and Nicolas Neubauer, will continue to lead the Ivoflow team, which joined Jaggaer as part of the transaction.
